claim: Theorem X and its finite idempotent-purity corollary
statement: Every regular locally orthodox semigroup S with a nonempty completely simple ideal has a surjective completely simple quotient q whose restriction to the ideal is idempotent pure. Weak E-unitarity makes q idempotent pure on all S; hence xi is idempotent pure for every finite member of the book class.
assumptions: S is a nonempty regular semigroup
S has a nonempty completely simple ideal K
For every idempotent e, eSe is orthodox
Weak E-unitarity is additionally required for purity on all S
